title: द्विचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks whether there is death, and Sanatsujata teaches that heedlessness is death and heedfulness immortality; men die through delusion and desire, and the wise who conquer these pass beyond death. He explains the paths to the eternal worlds through truth, uprightness and self-control.
summary.kn: ಮೃತ್ಯು ಇದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಪ್ರಮಾದವೇ ಮೃತ್ಯು, ಅಪ್ರಮಾದವೇ ಅಮೃತತ್ವ, ಮೋಹ ಕಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಮನುಷ್ಯರು ಸಾಯುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಗೆದ್ದ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಮೃತ್ಯುವನ್ನು ಮೀರುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಸನತ್ಸುಜಾತರು ಉಪದೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸತ್ಯ, ಆರ್ಜವ, ಸಂಯಮಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಲೋಕಗಳ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि क्या मृत्यु है, और सनत्सुजात सिखाते हैं कि प्रमाद ही मृत्यु है और अप्रमाद अमृतत्व; मनुष्य मोह और काम से मरते हैं, और इन्हें जीतने वाले ज्ञानी मृत्यु के पार जाते हैं। वे सत्य, सरलता और संयम से शाश्वत लोकों के मार्ग समझाते हैं।
summary.te: మృత్యువు ఉందా అని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడగగా, ప్రమాదమే మృత్యువు, అప్రమాదమే అమృతత్వమని, మోహం, కామం వల్ల మనుషులు మరణిస్తారని, వాటిని జయించిన జ్ఞానులు మృత్యువును దాటుతారని సనత్సుజాతుడు ఉపదేశిస్తాడు. సత్యం, ఆర్జవం, సంయమం ద్వారా శాశ్వత లోకాల మార్గాలను వివరిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: மரணம் உண்டா என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்க, கவனமின்மையே மரணம், கவனமே அமரத்துவம், மயக்கத்தாலும் ஆசையாலும் மனிதர் மடிகிறார்கள், அவற்றை வென்ற ஞானிகள் மரணத்தைக் கடக்கிறார்கள் என்று ஸனத்ஸுஜாதர் உபதேசிக்கிறார். உண்மை, நேர்மை, அடக்கம் மூலம் நித்திய உலகங்களுக்கான வழிகளை விளக்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: മരണമുണ്ടോ എന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; അശ്രദ്ധയാണ് മരണമെന്നും, ജാഗ്രതയാണ് അമരത്വമെന്നും സനത്സുജാതൻ പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. മോഹവും ആഗ്രഹവും കൊണ്ടാണ് മനുഷ്യർ മരിക്കുന്നത്; അവയെ ജയിക്കുന്ന ജ്ഞാനികൾ മരണത്തിനപ്പുറം കടക്കുന്നു. സത്യം, നേരുള്ള നടപ്പ്, ആത്മനിയന്ത്രണം എന്നിവയിലൂടെ നിത്യലോകങ്ങളിലേക്കുള്ള വഴികൾ അദ്ദേഹം വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.42; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो राजा धृतराष्ट्रो मनीषी
संपूज्य वाक्यं विदुरेरितं तत् ।
सनत्सुजातं रहिते महात्मा
पप्रच्छ बुद्धिं परमां बुभूषन् ॥

meaning.en: Then the wise King Dhritarashtra, honoring Vidura's words, in private questioned Sanatsujata, wishing to gain the highest understanding.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
सनत्सुजात यदीदं शृणोमि
मृत्युर्हि नास्तीति तवोपदेशम् ।
देवासुरा ह्याचरन्ब्रह्मचर्य-
ममृत्यवे तत्कतरन्नु सत्यम् ॥

meaning.en: Sanatsujata, I hear your teaching that there is no death. Yet gods and asuras practiced celibacy to be free of death; which of these is true?

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
अमृत्युः कर्मणा केचिन्मृत्युर्नास्तीति चापरे ।
शृणु मे ब्रुवतो राजन्यथैतन्मा विशङ्किथाः ॥

meaning.en: Some say that deathlessness comes from action, others that there is no death. Hear me as I explain, king, and do not doubt it.

verses.text:
उभे सत्ये क्षत्रियाद्यप्रवृत्ते
मोहो मृत्युः संमतो यः कवीनाम् ।
प्रमादं वै मृत्युमहं ब्रवीमि
सदाप्रमादममृतत्वं ब्रवीमि ॥

meaning.en: Both are true, this started by the kshatriya: that which the wise consider death is delusion. I say that carelessness is death, and carelessness-free state is deathlessness.

verses.text:
प्रमादाद्वै असुराः पराभव-
न्नप्रमादाद्ब्रह्मभूता भवन्ति ।
न वै मृत्युर्व्याघ्र इवात्ति जन्तू-
न्न ह्यस्य रूपमुपलभ्यते ह ॥

meaning.en: Through carelessness the asuras were defeated, and through carefulness they become one with Brahman. Death does not eat creatures like a tiger; its form is not seen at all.

verses.text:
यमं त्वेके मृत्युमतोऽन्यमाहु-
रात्मावसन्नममृतं ब्रह्मचर्यम् ।
पितृलोके राज्यमनुशास्ति देवः
शिवः शिवानामशिवोऽशिवानाम् ॥

meaning.en: Some call Yama death and others something else; they say celibacy, established in the self, is deathless. The god rules the kingdom in the world of ancestors, kind to the kind and unkind to the unkind.

verses.text:
आस्यादेष निःसरते नराणां
क्रोधः प्रमादो मोहरूपश्च मृत्युः ।
ते मोहितास्तद्वशे वर्तमाना
इतः प्रेतास्तत्र पुनः पतन्ति ॥

meaning.en: From the mouth of men comes forth anger, carelessness and death in the form of delusion. Deluded, living under their power, they die from here and fall down again there.

verses.text:
ततस्तं देवा अनु विप्लवन्ते
अतो मृत्युर्मरणाख्यामुपैति ।
कर्मोदये कर्मफलानुरागा-
स्तत्रानु यान्ति न तरन्ति मृत्युम् ॥

meaning.en: Then even the gods flow after them; from this Death gets the name of dying. When their deeds ripen, those attached to the fruit of deeds follow the deeds and do not cross Death.

verses.text:
योऽभिध्यायन्नुत्पतिष्णून्निहन्या-
दनादरेणाप्रतिबुध्यमानः ।
स वै मृत्युर्मृत्युरिवात्ति भूत्वा
एवं विद्वान्यो विनिहन्ति कामान् ॥

meaning.en: He who, brooding, destroys rising desires, without regard and without being awakened, he is Death himself, who devours as Death; so the wise man kills desires.

verses.text:
कामानुसारी पुरुषः कामाननु विनश्यति ।
कामान्व्युदस्य धुनुते यत्किंचित्पुरुषो रजः ॥

meaning.en: A man who follows desires perishes along with desires; but one who throws off desires shakes off whatever dust there is.

verses.text:
तमोऽप्रकाशो भूतानां नरकोऽयं प्रदृश्यते ।
गृह्यन्त इव धावन्ति गच्छन्तः श्वभ्रमुन्मुखाः ॥

meaning.en: This hell, a darkness without light for beings, is seen; they run as if seized, going with faces upturned to the pit.

verses.text:
अभिध्या वै प्रथमं हन्ति चैनं
कामक्रोधौ गृह्य चैनं तु पश्चात् ।
एते बालान्मृत्यवे प्रापयन्ति
धीरास्तु धैर्येण तरन्ति मृत्युम् ॥

meaning.en: Brooding first kills him, and desire and anger seize him afterward; these bring fools to death, but the steady cross death by steadiness.

verses.text:
अमन्यमानः क्षत्रिय किंचिदन्य-
न्नाधीयते तार्ण इवास्य व्याघ्रः ।
क्रोधाल्लोभान्मोहमयान्तरात्मा
स वै मृत्युस्त्वच्छरीरे य एषः ॥

meaning.en: Not thinking anything else, kshatriya, this one studies nothing, as the tiger does not study grass; the inner self made of anger, greed and delusion, that is the Death in your body.

verses.text:
एवं मृत्युं जायमानं विदित्वा
ज्ञाने तिष्ठन्न बिभेतीह मृत्योः ।
विनश्यते विषये तस्य मृत्यु-
र्मृत्योर्यथा विषयं प्राप्य मर्त्यः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing death thus as it arises, one who stands in knowledge does not fear death here; for him death perishes in his domain, as a mortal does when he reaches the domain of death.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
येऽस्मिन्धर्मान्नाचरन्तीह केचि-
त्तथा धर्मान्केचिदिहाचरन्ति ।
धर्मः पापेन प्रतिहन्यते स्म
उताहो धर्मः प्रतिहन्ति पापम् ॥

meaning.en: Some here do not practice the duties, while others practice them. Is dharma struck down by sin, or does dharma strike down sin?

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
उभयमेव तत्रोपभुज्यते फलं
धर्मस्यैवेतरस्य च ।
धर्मेणाधर्मं प्रणुदतीह विद्वा-
न्धर्मो बलीयानिति तस्य विद्धि ॥

meaning.en: Both fruits are enjoyed there, of dharma and of the other. The wise man drives away adharma by dharma; know that dharma is stronger.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
यानिमानाहुः स्वस्य धर्मस्य लोका-
न्द्विजातीनां पुण्यकृतां सनातनान् ।
तेषां परिक्रमान्कथयन्तस्ततोऽन्या-
न्नैतद्विद्वन्नैव कृतं च कर्म ॥

meaning.en: The eternal worlds they speak of for the twice-born who do good in their own dharma: telling their circuits to others, the knower does not say whether that comes from knowledge or from deeds.

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
येषां बले न विस्पर्धा बले बलवतामिव ।
ते ब्राह्मणा इतः प्रेत्य स्वर्गलोके प्रकाशते ॥

meaning.en: Those brahmins who do not compete in strength, as with the strength of the mighty, after death shine in the world of heaven.

verses.text:
यत्र मन्येत भूयिष्ठं प्रावृषीव तृणोलपम् ।
अन्नं पानं च ब्राह्मणस्तज्जीवन्नानुसंज्वरेत् ॥

meaning.en: Where he thinks that food and drink are plentiful, like grass in the rains, there a brahmin, while living, should not be distressed.

verses.text:
यत्राकथयमानस्य प्रयच्छत्यशिवं भयम् ।
अतिरिक्तमिवाकुर्वन्स श्रेयान्नेतरो जनः ॥

meaning.en: He who, when someone does not speak, causes him fear and ill, as if doing something in excess, is better than others; no one else.

verses.text:
यो वाकथयमानस्य आत्मानं नानुसंज्वरेत् ।
ब्रह्मस्वं नोपभुञ्जेद्वा तदन्नं संमतं सताम् ॥

meaning.en: He who does not burn with regret for himself when another does not tell, nor eats the property of brahmins: that food is approved by the good.

verses.text:
यथा स्वं वान्तमश्नाति श्वा वै नित्यमभूतये ।
एवं ते वान्तमश्नन्ति स्ववीर्यस्योपजीवनात् ॥

meaning.en: As a dog always eats its own vomit to its harm, so they eat their vomit, living on their own strength.

verses.text:
नित्यमज्ञातचर्या मे इति मन्येत ब्राह्मणः ।
ज्ञातीनां तु वसन्मध्ये नैव विद्येत किंचन ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin should think, "My conduct is always unknown"; living among his kinsmen he knows nothing at all.

verses.text:
को ह्येवमन्तरात्मानं ब्राह्मणो हन्तुमर्हति ।
तस्माद्धि किंचित्क्षत्रिय ब्रह्मावसति पश्यति ॥

meaning.en: What brahmin should kill his inner self thus? Therefore a kshatriya, as Brahman abides, sees something.

verses.text:
अश्रान्तः स्यादनादानात्संमतो निरुपद्रवः ।
शिष्टो न शिष्टवत्स स्याद्ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवित्कविः ॥

meaning.en: He should be untired, not by taking, honored, free from harm; a brahmin who knows Brahman, a sage, being good, should not be like the good.

verses.text:
अनाढ्या मानुषे वित्ते आढ्या वेदेषु ये द्विजाः ।
ते दुर्धर्षा दुष्प्रकम्प्या विद्यात्तान्ब्रह्मणस्तनुम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins who are poor in human wealth but rich in the Vedas are unassailable and unshakable; know them to be the body of Brahman.

verses.text:
सर्वान्स्विष्टकृतो देवान्विद्याद्य इह कश्चन ।
न समानो ब्राह्मणस्य यस्मिन्प्रयतते स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever here knows all the gods as bringing results, no one is equal to a brahmin in whom he himself strives.

verses.text:
यमप्रयतमानं तु मानयन्ति स मानितः ।
न मान्यमानो मन्येत नामानादभिसंज्वरेत् ॥

meaning.en: He whom they honor, though not striving, is honored; the honored one should not think himself honored, and not be distressed at dishonor.

verses.text:
विद्वांसो मानयन्तीह इति मन्येत मानितः ।
अधर्मविदुषो मूढा लोकशास्त्रविशारदाः ।
न मान्यं मानयिष्यन्ति इति मन्येदमानितः ॥

meaning.en: "The learned honor me here," he should think when honored; the fools, ignorant of adharma but clever in worldly lore, will not honor the honorable, he should think when dishonored.

verses.text:
न वै मानं च मौनं च सहितौ चरतः सदा ।
अयं हि लोको मानस्य असौ मानस्य तद्विदुः ॥

meaning.en: Honor and silence do not move together always; this world belongs to honor, that world to silence, so they know.

verses.text:
श्रीः सुखस्येह संवासः सा चापि परिपन्थिनी ।
ब्राह्मी सुदुर्लभा श्रीर्हि प्रज्ञाहीनेन क्षत्रिय ॥

meaning.en: Prosperity dwells with happiness here, yet is also an obstacle; the Brahmic prosperity is hard to win for one without wisdom, kshatriya.

verses.text:
द्वाराणि तस्या हि वदन्ति सन्तो
बहुप्रकाराणि दुरावराणि ।
सत्यार्जवे ह्रीर्दमशौचविद्याः
षण्मानमोहप्रतिबाधनानि ॥

meaning.en: The good declare its doors to be many and hard to close: truth, honesty, modesty, self-control, purity and learning, six that obstruct pride and delusion.
